mapper.sql: select cpvc_llave as llaveTabla ,cpvc_documento as documento ,cpvc_campo as campo ,cpvc_valortext as valorText ,dpvc_valorfecha as valorFecha ,cpvc_valoropcion as valorOpcion ,cpvc_valorauxiliar as valorAuxiliar ,mpvc_valornumero as valorNumero ,cpvc_transaccionregistro as transaccionRegistro ,cpvc_transaccioninactivo as transaccionInactivo ,cpvc_estado as estado from pedidoventacaracteristica_pvcp a
mapper.select: select count(*) from pedidoventacaracteristica_pvcp

update pedidoventacaracteristica_pvcp set cpvc_documento = #{documento}, cpvc_campo = #{campo}, cpvc_valortext = #{valorText}, dpvc_valorfecha = #{valorFecha}, cpvc_valoropcion = #{valorOpcion}, cpvc_valorauxiliar = #{valorAuxiliar}, mpvc_valornumero = #{valorNumero}, cpvc_transaccionregistro = #{transaccionRegistro}, cpvc_transaccioninactivo = #{transaccionInactivo}, cpvc_estado =#{estado}
where cpvc_documento = #{documento} and cpvc_estado ='A' and cpvc_campo = #{campo}

select cpvc_llave as llaveTabla ,cpvc_documento as documento ,cpvc_campo as campo ,cpvc_valortext as valorText ,dpvc_valorfecha as valorFecha ,cpvc_valoropcion as valorOpcion ,cpvc_valorauxiliar as valorAuxiliar ,mpvc_valornumero as valorNumero ,cpvc_transaccionregistro as transaccionRegistro ,cpvc_transaccioninactivo as transaccionInactivo ,cpvc_estado as estado from historic.z_pvc_pedidoventacaracteristica where cpvc_documento = #{documento} and cpvc_estado ='A' and cpvc_campo = #{campo}

select cpvc_llave as llaveTabla ,cdpc_nombre as campo ,cdpc_llave as transaccionRegistro ,cdpc_codigo as transaccionInactivo ,cpvc_documento as documento ,cpvc_valortext as valorText ,dpvc_valorfecha as valorFecha ,cpvc_valoropcion as valorOpcion ,mpvc_valornumero as valorNumero ,cdpc_formato as estado ,ndpc_orden as orden from pedidoventacaracteristica_pvcp a inner join documentoplantillacaracteristica_dpcp on (cpvc_campo = cdpc_llave and cdpc_estado = 'A') inner join propiedad_ppdp on (cppd_campo = cdpc_llave and cppd_propiedadvalor = 'PROP_104' and cppd_estado = 'A') where cpvc_estado ='A' and cpvc_documento in (#{item.llaveTabla})
union select cpvc_llave as llaveTabla ,cdpc_nombre as campo ,cdpc_llave as transaccionRegistro ,cdpc_codigo as transaccionInactivo ,cpvc_documento as documento ,cpvc_valortext as valorText ,dpvc_valorfecha as valorFecha ,cpvc_valoropcion as valorOpcion ,mpvc_valornumero as valorNumero ,cdpc_formato as estado ,ndpc_orden as orden from historic.z_pvc_pedidoventacaracteristica inner join documentoplantillacaracteristica_dpcp on (cpvc_campo = cdpc_llave and cdpc_estado = 'A') inner join propiedad_ppdp on (cppd_campo = cdpc_llave and cppd_propiedadvalor = 'PROP_104' and cppd_estado = 'A') where cpvc_estado ='A' and cpvc_documento in (#{item.llaveTabla})
order by orden

select cdpc_codigo as campo ,cpvc_valortext as valorText ,dpvc_valorfecha as valorFecha ,cpvc_valoropcion as valorOpcion ,mpvc_valornumero as valorNumero ,cpvc_valorauxiliar as valorAuxiliar ,cdpc_formato as estado from pedidoventacaracteristica_pvcp a, documentoplantillacaracteristica_dpcp where cpvc_campo = cdpc_llave and cpvc_documento = #{documento} and cpvc_estado ='A' order by ndpc_orden

select cdpc_nombre as campo ,cpvc_valortext as valorText from pedidoventacaracteristica_pvcp inner join documentoplantillacaracteristica_dpcp on (cpvc_campo = cdpc_llave) where cpvc_documento = #{documento} and cpvc_transaccionregistro = #{transaccion} order by ndpc_orden

select cpvc_llave as llaveTabla ,cpvc_campo as campo ,cpvc_valortext as valorText ,cpvc_valoropcion as valorOpcion ,cpvc_valorauxiliar as valorAuxiliar ,null as estado from pedidoventacaracteristica_pvcp a inner join documentoplantillacaracteristica_dpcp on (cdpc_llave = cpvc_campo and cdpc_estado = 'A' and cdpc_formato ='Z') inner join propiedad_ppdp on (cppd_campo =cdpc_llave and cppd_estado ='A' ) inner join propiedadvalordefinido_pvdp on (cppd_propiedadvalor = cpvd_llave and cpvd_codigo = 'PROCESO_GESTIONAR_ESTADOS' and cpvd_origen = 'C') where cpvc_documento =#{documento} and cpvc_estado = 'A' union select 'CAMPO_HEREDADO' as llaveTabla ,cdpc_llave as campo ,crit_campo as valorText ,null as valorOpcion ,crit_plantilla as valorAuxiliar ,null as estado from pedidoventa_pdvp inner join documentoplantillacaracteristica_dpcp on (cdpc_plantilla = cpdv_plantilla and cdpc_estado = 'A') inner join propiedad_ppdp param_bpm on (param_bpm.cppd_campo = cdpc_llave and param_bpm.cppd_estado = 'A' and param_bpm.cppd_propiedadvalor = 'PROP_37') inner join propiedad_ppdp param_herencia on (param_herencia.cppd_campo = cdpc_llave and param_herencia.cppd_estado = 'A' and param_herencia.cppd_propiedadvalor = 'PROP_33') inner join relacioninterna_ritp on (crit_propiedad = param_herencia.cppd_llave and crit_estado = 'A') where cpdv_llave = #{documento} union select 'CAMPO_DETALLE' as llaveTabla ,cdpc_llave as campo ,null as valorText ,cdpv_detalleid as valorOpcion ,null as valorAuxiliar ,null as estado from pedidoventa_pdvp inner join documentoplantillacaracteristica_dpcp dpc on (dpc.cdpc_plantilla = cpdv_plantilla and dpc.cdpc_estado = 'A' and dpc.cdpc_formato = 'J') inner join detallepedidoventa_dpvp det on det.cdpv_documento = #{documento} --and det.cdpv_campo = dpc.cdpc_llave where cpdv_llave = #{documento}
select propiedad_${sqlFuncionCalculo} (#{documento}, #{token}, array[#{item.valorOpcion}#{item.valorText}]null)
select propiedad_${sqlFuncionCalculo} (#{documento}, #{token}, array[#{item.valorOpcion}#{item.valorText}]null)
inner join documentoplantillacaracteristica_dpcp on ( cdpc_llave = cpvc_campo and cdpc_estado = 'A') where cpvc_documento = #{nombreDocumento} and cpvc_estado = 'A' and cdpc_formato = 'B'

select cpvc_valortext as valorText ,dpvc_valorfecha as valorFecha ,cpvc_valoropcion as valorOpcion ,mpvc_valornumero as valorNumero ,cpvc_documento as documento ,cpdv_plantilla as valorAuxiliar ,cpdv_estadoexpediente as estado ,(select cpes_nombre from procesoestado_pesp where cpes_llave = cpdv_estadoexpediente) as transaccionRegistro from propiedad_${sqlFuncionCalculo} (#{campoId}, #{token}, array[#{item.valorOpcion}]null) inner join pedidoventa_pdvp on (cpdv_llave = cpvc_documento)

select cdpf_codigo as campo ,cpvc_valortext as valorText from propiedad_ppdp inner join relacioninterna_ritp on (crit_propiedad = cppd_llave and crit_estado = 'A' and crit_plantilla = #{plantilla}) inner join campo_documento cp_principal on (cp_principal.cdrc_documento = #{documento} and cp_principal.cpvc_campo = crit_campo ) where cppd_llave = #{propiedad} union select cp_detalle.cdpf_codigo as campo ,cp_detalle.cpvc_valortext as valorText from propiedad_ppdp inner join relacioninterna_ritp on (crit_propiedad = cppd_llave and crit_estado = 'A' and crit_plantilla != #{plantilla}) inner join campo_documento cp_principal on (cp_principal.cdrc_documento = #{documento}) inner join campo_documento cp_detalle on (cp_detalle.cdrc_documento = cp_principal.cpvc_valoropcion and crit_campo = cp_detalle.cpvc_campo ) where cppd_llave = #{propiedad}
union select cp_principal.cdpf_codigo as campo ,cp_principal.cpvc_valortext as valorText from propiedad_ppdp inner join relacioninterna_ritp on (crit_propiedad = cppd_llave and crit_estado = 'A' and crit_plantilla != #{plantilla}) inner join campo_documento cp_principal on (cp_principal.cdrc_documento = #{modificador}) where cppd_llave = #{propiedad}
where cpvc_documento in (#{itemA.valorOpcion}) and cpvc_estado ='A' and cpvc_campo in (#{itemB.campo})

if.foreach: select cpvc_llave as llaveTabla ,cpvc_documento as documento ,cpvc_campo as campo ,cpvc_valortext as valorText ,dpvc_valorfecha as valorFecha ,cpvc_valoropcion as valorOpcion ,(select d.cpdv_nombre from pedidoventa_pdvp d where d.cpdv_llave = cpvc_valoropcion) cpvc_valorauxiliar as valorAuxiliar ,mpvc_valornumero as valorNumero ,#{itemA.llaveTabla} as estado from pedidoventa_pdvp pv cross join campo4documento(pv.cpdv_llave, pv.npdv_historico) a where pv.cpdv_llave = #{itemA.valorOpcion} and cpvc_estado ='A' and cpvc_campo = #{itemB.campo}

mapper.select: select cpdv_plantilla from pedidoventa_pdvp where cpdv_llave = #{documento}

select cpvc_valortext as valorText ,dpvc_valorfecha as valorFecha ,cpvc_valoropcion as valorOpcion ,cpvc_valorauxiliar as valorAuxiliar ,mpvc_valornumero as valorNumero from propiedad_${sqlFuncionCalculo} (#{llaveTablaDocumento}, #{llaveTablaModificador}, null)
select cpvc_valortext as valorText from propiedad_${sqlFuncion} (#{llaveTablaDocumento})
update historic.z_pvc_pedidoventacaracteristicapedidoventacaracteristica_pvcp set cpvc_transaccioninactivo = #{transaccion}, cpvc_estado = 'I' where cpvc_llave = #{idCampo}

select (select cpdv_nombre from pedidoventa_pdvp where cpdv_llave = cpvc_valoropcion) as llaveTabla ,cpvc_documento as documento ,cpvc_campo as campo ,cpvc_valortext as valorText ,dpvc_valorfecha as valorFecha ,cpvc_valoropcion as valorOpcion ,cpvc_valorauxiliar as valorAuxiliar ,mpvc_valornumero as valorNumero from pedidoventacaracteristica_pvcp pp where pp.cpvc_estado = 'A' and pp.cpvc_documento = #{pKeyBase} and pp.cpvc_campo = (select dc.cdpc_llave from documentoplantillacaracteristica_dpcp dc inner join documentoplantilla_dplp dp on dp.cdpl_llave = dc.cdpc_plantilla where dc.cdpc_codigo = #{pCodeTemplate} and dp.cdpl_codigo = #{pTemplate})
